title: Khoja-Khuji
details: Khoja-Khuji is a web-based Lost & Found Management System designed to make it easier for users to report, search, and manage lost and found items.
The system follows the MVC architecture and uses PHP for the backend with MySQL for data management.

title: IEEE-AIUB Event Toolkit
details: IEEE-AIUB Event Toolkit is a web-based event management utility designed to simplify participant management and attendance sheet generation.
The application provides a live preview and allows users to export attendance sheets in PDF and Word formats.

title: Data Science NLP Analysis
details: A Natural Language Processing project focused on text preprocessing, feature extraction, and machine learning-based text classification.
The project uses TF-IDF for feature extraction and compares different machine learning models based on their classification performance.

title: Computer Graphics: Village View
details: A computer graphics project that creates a graphical village environment using OpenGL.
The project demonstrates geometric transformations, rendering techniques, and basic animation.

title: Hostel Management System
details: A role-based hostel management system designed to manage hostel-related operations using object-oriented programming.
The application follows a modular architecture to organize different management functionalities.

title: Bus Ticket Management System
details: A structured bus ticket management application developed using Java and object-oriented programming principles.
The system focuses on organizing ticket-related operations through a modular application structure.

title: Enhancement on Pathao App
details: A software analysis and product planning project focused on identifying possible improvements for the Pathao mobile application.
The project proposes new features and user experience improvements to make the application more useful and convenient.

title: Arduino Smart Mop/Brush Cleaner Robot
details: An autonomous cleaning robot designed to assist with floor cleaning using Arduino-based control.
The robot uses an ultrasonic sensor to detect obstacles and navigate its environment in real time.

title: Arduino Fire & Smoke Detection System
details: A real-time fire and smoke detection system developed using Arduino and multiple sensors.
The system monitors environmental conditions and provides alerts when fire or smoke is detected.

title: DC Mobile Charger with Fast Charging
details: An adjustable DC mobile charging system designed to provide regulated power for mobile devices.
The project focuses on power conversion, voltage regulation, and fast-charging control.
